name: pipeline
description: The working pipeline's live half: pins a by-hand gate-check to this session, shows the Stop hook's WARN lines and the session-start alarms above the prompt, delivers oversized SessionStart context whole, attaches a §0 class hint to each prompt, and refuses a review agent with no diff or a second fix-diff in one task.

classify.title: §0 class hint
classify.description: Classify each typed prompt with the small fast model and attach the label as a hint for the model (and show it above the prompt)

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Show the session-start alarms, the gate-check WARN count and the class hint above the prompt
